verdict: The red car carries two sensor languages at once: Prototype 9's hatch, headlight wedge and side outlines, and Prototype 10's cones. They disagree on reach, on side, and on whether a blind car can see. The cones also ignore height and cover. As a result the screen telegraphs none of the nine twists before the player fails, and in puzzle 1 it points the player away from the solution.

signals.mark: MISSED: lesson clip replays the P9 marks
signals.player_reads: 'As the car saw it': a forward hatch on a blind car (1_A1_lesson_clip x 640-960 y 645-750)

findings.what: Forward sight is drawn up to four times over: P9 hatch (fwdLen), P9 headlight wedge, rung-1 band (fwdLen), and P10 forward cone (340). The lengths differ and the shapes overlap. In 3_C1_a the hatch (x 740-1230) sits inside the cone (x 740-1320) under the headlight. The P9 side dotted fill fires on the side away from the dummy (8_B3_b).
findings.player_reads: Several zones of unclear meaning. Which edge is the danger?
findings.truth: RED-01 has one forward camera with one reach and one stopping distance. The P9 marks belong to the white cars' rule.
findings.fix: Gate all P9 sensor marks (hatch, side outlines, dotted fill, headlight wedge, notice flash) off for RED-01 when s.p11 is set. White cars keep them. RED-01 keeps its lamps. Draw one forward ribbon (see sensor_feedback rung 1).

findings.what: At rung 0 the blind car draws a forward hatch, side arcs, a headlight wedge and an awareness bar. The training clip says the car 'saw' the hatch.
findings.player_reads: It sees its lane, so stay out of it. That is the opposite of the solution, 'stand in its lane'. It also contradicts the hint 'It cannot see you'.
findings.fix: Rung 0 draws nothing but the lamps and the plate with 7 empty squares. The clip replays the overlay of the car's rung at the time of the hit.

findings.what: The side and forward fans paint over decks, escalators, buildings, kiosks and hedges. Nothing is clipped by height or cover. 3_C1_a: the fan covers the Z2 deck and both escalators (x 600-1080 y 240-480). 6_A3_a: the red has-you sector covers the kiosk (x 840-895 y 405-515). 8_B3_a: the fan covers the hedge (x 350-540 y 470-515).
findings.player_reads: Height and cover do not matter, which cancels the twists of puzzles 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8.
findings.truth: The side sensors see the ground at perception.sensorHeight 14. Tall cover hides you. Low cover hides you only when ducked.
findings.fix: Ray-cast each fan. Stop it at tall cover (shadow wedge behind it). Low cover casts a shadow only while the dummy is ducked, so the shadow appears when the player presses C. Leave deck tops unpainted below rung 3.

findings.what: The street camera is about 8 px at 2x and its pan cone cannot be seen while idle. In 9_C3_a the cone (x 900-1260) is the same grey-green as the side fans.
findings.player_reads: The cabinet or kiosk is safe cover. The camera is decoration.
findings.truth: The camera watches 60° to 180 px and pans 60° every 3 s. It reports you to the car.
findings.fix: Draw the mint pan cone always (idle α 0.08). It brightens when you are inside, and LINKED fires on catch. Enlarge the post (proposed 8 px lens at 1x). Mark the dash-break point on the post.

findings.what: Puzzle 2's new idea is the stop line, but it draws only once the car brakes. Before a failure the only cue is the unlabelled hatch length. Edit 115 §115.4: the cut-in bot logs 0 hits / 8 your-fault contacts.
findings.player_reads: No window is visible; stepping in feels random.
findings.truth: There is a band between the nose and the stopping distance where stepping in gets you hit.
findings.fix: From rung 1, draw a dashed stop line at fwdLen ahead at all times. Shade the nose-to-line band as 'too late to stop' in white α 0.12. The line goes solid when braking.

findings.what: Lesson 3 says roof lidar sees a dummy jumping or falling off a deck. Edit 115 §115.4 measured that it does not close a deck drop, and A2's drop still clears. No puzzle is played at rung 3: puzzle 4 teaches 2→4 at once.
findings.player_reads: Drops are closed, so stop trying them. Or: the card lied.
findings.truth: Rung 3 changes nothing a player can feel.
findings.fix: Either make lidar close drops within a proposed perception.lidarRange and show its sweep on deck edges, or fold rung 3 into rung 4's lesson and drop the drop claim from the card.

findings.what: Caught states use yellow (the dummy's colour) and red (the car's colour). The dummy turns orange inside the red sector (4_B2_b x 395-445 y 675-750). Cones turn invisible on red (6_A3_a x 925-955 y 415-445). A dithered dummy disappears in the yellow fill (5_A2_b_car x 170-230 y 215-300).
findings.player_reads: The dummy and the cones vanish at the moment of truth.
findings.fix: State is shown by brightness in the sensor's own colour, plus a corner-bracket box round the dummy in that colour. Remove the yellow and red fills.

findings.what: Above the car sit a P9 plate, a tag about 350 px wide, ?/!, 3 pips, a track bar, a notice ring and P9 speech bubbles. They cover the dummy, its arrow and the fans. In 9_C3_r7 a label ending 'EN' collides with the tag end (x 770-800 y 945-960).
findings.player_reads: A pile of labels; the dummy is lost.
findings.truth: Rung and alert state are two facts.
findings.fix: Keep the plate, with ?/! on it and 7 squares under it. Cut the tag text, pips and track bar. Cut the bubbles on RED-01. Move the notice arc to the dummy.

findings.what: The forward hatch and headlight run straight ahead while the lane curves. They cross buildings (6_A3_b x 375-480 y 600-1220), a deck (8_B3_a) and other roads (7_C2_a).
findings.player_reads: It sees through buildings, and will drive there.
findings.truth: It drives and brakes along its lane path.
findings.fix: Draw the forward ribbon along the lane polyline. At rung 4, a cone in the lane bends the ribbon round the cone (swerve preview). At rung 5, the ribbon ends at the cone with the stop line.

findings.what: The lesson card shows CLOSED and NEXT but no OPEN line. NEXT repeats the new rule ('It stops for you in its lane') instead of the trick still open (LESSON[1][2]: cut in). The fitting close-up is not in the shot because the card covers the field.
findings.player_reads: What is closed, but not what to try.
findings.truth: The ladder works as 'closed X, open Y'.
findings.fix: Add an OPEN row from LESSON[n][2]. Make NEXT name the puzzle and its open trick. Show the fitting with the new sensor's field drawn on the road before the card.

findings.what: At rung 6 no memory ring is visible: only a chalk figure with a yellow triangle (x 635-700 y 550-640). The tallies cannot be counted. At rung 7 the amber ghost, search ring, STOPS HERE label and escalator overlap (x 560-870 y 980-1210).
findings.player_reads: The boss's two new rungs have no on-field shape. The player learns them by repeating a move and failing.
findings.truth: It watches up to 3 spots of radius 50, then searches 60 px for 4 s.
findings.fix: Rung 6: a red numbered ring per site that brightens as the car nears. Rung 7: a red dashed ghost silhouette whose single ring empties over duel.searchSeconds. Draw the STOPS HERE label on the side away from the ghost.

findings.what: The HUD covers the car: the strip hides RED-01 and its tag (7_C2_b x 1190-1260 y 160-280), and the panel covers the plate (6_A3_b).
findings.player_reads: The car disappears at the decision point.
findings.truth: The lane passes under the HUD.
findings.fix: Fade the HUD to α 0.3 while the car or dummy is under it, or keep lanes out of a 130 px top band in each puzzle's layout.

findings.what: One sensor has several reaches in the registry. Forward: perception.forwardLength 720, perception.coneRadius 340, fwdLen. Side: perception.sideRadius 100, perception.sideCloseRange 180, the derived 227, perception.sideConeRange 240, perception.sideWaryRange 360. The rings draw at the 2 grades of 227, but the stages act at 180 and 360 (360 lies beyond the fan).
findings.player_reads: The forward reach shrinks from rung 1 to rung 2. The rings do not line up with SLOWING or STOPPING.
findings.fix: One id per reach. Rings at the thresholds the sim acts on. sideWaryRange must not exceed the fan reach. Retire perception.sideRadius and perception.sideHalfAngle for RED-01.

findings.what: Kit pieces are 2-4 px and misleading. The mint fin ring reads as 'camera'. The puck renders white and its spin cannot be seen. The bumper strip merges with the stop line at the nose. The yellow tallies look like lamps.
findings.player_reads: Which sensor this car has is unreadable at play size.
findings.fix: Kit is a label only. Each piece pulses in step with its field the first time that field acts in a puzzle. Recolour the puck to steel blue, and the tallies and searchlight to red.

findings.what: Level art competes with the overlay. Cyan escalator corner brackets look like detection boxes. Kiosk cyan screens read as camera lenses (7_C2_a x 720-770). Hedge and planter (8_B3_a) look like the tall cover. The island kiosk reads as an LED sign (4_B2_a x 770-820 y 715-770). MOVE ALONG fires at the hiding spot (5_A2_a, 7_C2_a). LED diagonal stripes echo the hatch.
findings.player_reads: Cover and cameras do not read as puzzle pieces. The game pushes you out of the intended hiding spot.
findings.truth: Cover height and camera placement are the puzzle.
findings.fix: Cover gets one readable outline and a height cue: tall casts a ground shadow, low gets a short lip. Use one camera post design. Escalators lose their brackets. Cut MOVE ALONG in P11. Hatch is gone (F1).

sensor_feedback.feedback: A white ribbon along the lane path, car width + 2 × body.radius wide, to forward reach. The nose-to-stopping-distance segment is shaded as 'too late'. A dashed stop line sits at its end. No hatch, no headlight wedge.

states.idle: Ribbon edges α 0.10; too-late band α 0.12; stop line dashed
states.sensing: Dummy inside the ribbon beyond the line: white corner box on the dummy, stop line goes solid, STOPS HERE label
states.caught: Car stops at the line, box flashes once, caption IT BRAKES FOR YOU in the bottom band

sensor_feedback.leaves_open: Stepping into the too-late band from beside the road

sensor_feedback.feedback: Two steel-blue ground fans at 10°-95° off the nose. They are ray-cast: they stop at tall cover and at deck edges, and low cover shades them only when the dummy is ducked. One dashed ring sits at the close threshold. Returns are short steel-blue ticks on the dummy's edge facing the car.

states.sensing: Returns on the dummy; a steel-blue arc round the dummy fills over the notice time (×1.5 ducked); ? on the plate
states.caught: Steel-blue corner box on the dummy; the sector containing the dummy goes to α 0.35; ! on the plate; stop line drops

params: perception.sideConeRange 240 vs (derived) side cone reach 227: pick one
sensor_feedback.leaves_open: Height: decks and parapet gaps above the fans

sensor_feedback.feedback: A thin steel-blue sweep line rotating 360° round the roof. Where it crosses deck edges and parapet gaps inside its reach, it leaves fading return dots, so it visibly covers the sky. An airborne dummy inside reach collects returns.

states.idle: Sweep line α 0.15, deck-edge returns α 0.2 fading over one rotation
states.sensing: Airborne dummy within reach: returns on the dummy, arc filling
states.caught: Steel-blue box on the airborne dummy, ! on the plate, stop line drops

sensor_feedback.closes: The drop and jump. Not true in the sim today (Edit 115 §115.4); fix the sim or cut the claim (F6)

sensor_feedback.on_car: Link fin, mint antenna stub; pulses only while linked
sensor_feedback.feedback: Drawn on the world camera, not the car: an enlarged post with a mint lens, and a mint 60° cone panning across its arc, always visible. The cone casts the same cover shadows as the fans, from a height of 60.

states.idle: Mint cone α 0.08 panning; post lens steady
states.sensing: Dummy inside the cone: cone α 0.2, mint arc filling on the dummy
states.caught: LINKED: mint dashed dummy → post → car, mint box on the dummy, fin pulses, ! on the plate

sensor_feedback.closes: Springing from cover a camera watches
sensor_feedback.leaves_open: Unwatched cover; breaking a post; the cone bait

sensor_feedback.feedback: An orange corner bracket on every cone inside the forward ribbon. Before rung 5, the ribbon bends round a cone in the lane (swerve preview). From rung 5, it ends at the cone with the stop line.

states.sensing: Cone inside the ribbon: orange bracket
states.caught: Stop line placed short of the cone; ribbon ends there; no swerve

sensor_feedback.leaves_open: Ducking behind low cover, then springing

sensor_feedback.on_car: Three tally marks on the bonnet, red, one filled per site
sensor_feedback.feedback: A red numbered ring at each remembered spot. Fans grow per memory, and the growth is visible as the fan edge stepping out.

states.sensing: Car approaching the site: ring solid and brightening
states.caught: Dummy inside a ring as the car passes: red box, ! on the plate, stop line drops

sensor_feedback.on_car: Searchlight on the roof front, red, sweeps while searching
sensor_feedback.feedback: A red dashed dummy silhouette (the ghost) at the last-seen point. One ring round it empties as the countdown. A narrow searchlight wedge sweeps inside the ring.

states.sensing: Seen, then lost: ghost and full ring appear, ring empties, searchlight sweeps
states.caught: Dummy inside the ring when the searchlight crosses: red box, !, stop line drops

sensor_feedback.leaves_open: Hiding before it sees you; leaving the ring before it empties

puzzles.name: First Contact
puzzles.misread: A hatch, side arcs and a headlight wedge suggest it sees its lane (1_A1_a, 1_A1_b), so the player avoids the lane.
puzzles.fix: Rung 0 draws nothing but lamps and the plate with 7 empty squares. The clip replays without the P9 marks.

puzzles.name: Stop Line
puzzles.misread: No stop line is shown before braking (2_B1_a/b). Three overlapping forward shapes give no window.
puzzles.fix: A persistent dashed stop line and a 'too late' band from rung 1. The lens bar glints at the first pass.

puzzles.name: High Road
puzzles.new: Side sensors: it sees the kerb
puzzles.misread: The fans cover the Z2 deck and both escalators (3_C1_a), so the deck looks watched and the drop looks closed.
puzzles.fix: Ground-clipped fans: deck tops and the parapet gap stay unpainted, which makes the gap read as the hole in its sight.

puzzles.name: The Island
puzzles.misread: The island kiosk reads as an LED sign (4_B2_a x 770-820 y 715-770). Fans paint over it with no shadow. The lunge guide is white and reads as a goal.
puzzles.fix: Kiosk with a cover outline that casts a fan shadow. Yellow lunge guide that brightens when the dash lands ahead of the nose. Card 4 must name the dash.

puzzles.name: CCTV
puzzles.new: Street cameras; a dash breaks a post
puzzles.misread: The camera cannot be seen (5_A2_a/b), so the cabinet looks safe. MOVE ALONG pushes the player out of cover. The drop still clears because lidar is not closing it.
